verdict: With zero paid spend and no leads generated in the last 28 days, the account is running entirely on organic activity, where GBP engagement is the standout concern, dropping 58.93% over the past 7 days versus the prior period, likely driven by reduced search demand or a loss of local pack visibility. The 178 total GBP actions (61 calls, 117 web clicks) over 28 days represent the only meaningful traffic source, making that GBP decline the top priority to investigate.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — $0 Meta, $0 Google. No leads generated. Account is entirely dark on paid channels.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31. No signed contract gates the next 3 months of paid activity.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact-rate bottleneck remains unresolved with 16 GHL contacts and 0 opportunities created.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 2) after averaging ~8/day earlier in August — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
Search clicks dropped to 0 on Sep 2 after holding 16–43/day for two weeks; sc_7d down -23.12%. Daily verdict's GBP focus is correct but understates the search-click collapse.
